Checkout refuses exact payments on 3-for-2 offers since money.py's rounding
was switched to ROUND_HALF_UP. Three tins at 1.99 on the 3-for-2 offer cost
3.98; the customer pays 3.98 and checkout raises PaymentError
("paid 3.98 but the total is 5.97"). round_cents must be rounding the offer
price wrongly; please fix the rounding.

    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("1.99", 3, "3for2")
    cart.checkout("3.98")
